author: Inside Edition
description: A woman says she wore her wedding dress to work for a good reason. She wants Taylor Swift to finally release a photo of her wedding gown. Anna Zapotosky, host of the radio show "Anna and Raven" in Milford, Connecticut, made a video asking other women to join in the playful protest. Swift wore a dress designed by Jonathan Anderson from Christian Dior. Inside Edition learned more details about the wedding of Swift Travis Kelce.
title: Woman Wears Her Wedding Dress To Work In Hopes Of Photo Release Of Taylor Swift's Wedding Gown

author: Inside Edition
description: These were not the photos a couple was expecting to take when they went on a fishing trip in Maine. Elvia and Todd Malcolm say it all happened so fast, but they were able to get a few pictures of a bear chasing a moose calf through the woods. While the shots came out great, they felt guilty about just being spectators, so they drove their vehicle between predator and prey. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Couple Snaps Photos Of Bear Chasing Moose Calf Through Woods
